segments.text:
V. 56.
He ſaw it—By Faith, in Types, Figures, and Promiſes. As particularly in M•lchiſedic: In the Appearance of Jehovah to him in the Plains of Mamre (Gen. xviii. 1.) And in the Promiſe, that in his Seed all the nations of the earth ſhould be bleſſed. Poſſibly he had likewiſe a peculiar Revelation, either of Chriſt's firſt or ſecond Coming.
